settings.title: Language Settings
settings.intro: Choose whether this company also runs in a local language, and what each branch defaults to.
settings.enableLocalHint: When off, the whole software runs in English. Nothing is deleted.
settings.branchHint: The defaults below are for this branch only; each branch keeps its own.
settings.savesItself: Saved with this Save button — the branch Update does not save these.
settings.confirmOff: The software will run in English. No data will be deleted.
settings.notPermitted: You are not permitted to change language settings.
settings.saveFailed: Could not save the language settings.
